BirthdayConfig.LetterText:
Dearest Piu ❤️,

I wanted to make your birthday a little different this year, so I made this little surprise just for you.

Every moment with you is special to me. I hope this journey made you smile, even a little, because I really love seeing you smile.

I hope this year brings you lots of happiness, beautiful memories, and many moments that make you smile.

Happy Birthday, Piu! 🎂💗

BirthdayConfig.FinalMessage: I’m truly grateful to have you in my life...Stay happy and safe, always!
BirthdayConfig.FinalMessageSub: Thank you for being such a wonderful one and for making so many moments special...annnndddd HAAPPYY wala Birthday to YOU..Hope this makes you a little happy. ❤️
